model_scope: Torchvision Mask R-CNN ResNet50 FPN v2, strict checkpoint load then bbox-only branch

protocol.dataset: 16 COCO val2017 images with conventional zero-based COCO80 YOLO bounding-box labels
protocol.split: same ordered images in every seed; support and evaluation disjoint by path and image bytes
protocol.prior_exploration: An earlier two-support/four-evaluation probe used the same 16-image pool; the four/twelve expansion retained hyperparameters. This is exploratory, not an untouched or preregistered confirmatory test.
protocol.seed_semantics: initialization and training stochasticity; no dataset resampling
protocol.teacher: same-arm frozen pre-adaptation predictions on shifted support, generated once
protocol.metric: pycocotools COCOeval bbox on the selected YOLO-label subset; not full COCO validation-set performance
protocol.metric_scale: 0 to 1; multiply by 100 for AP points
protocol.quantization: symmetric INT4 per output channel packed in uint8; transient FP32 dequantization; not original NF4 QLoRA or accelerated INT4 arithmetic

storage.semantics: resident parameter/buffer tensor storage; excludes activations, gradients, optimizer state, transient dequantized weights and process/runtime overhead

result.interpretation: The storage path and adapter updates executed. TTT did not recover COCO AP in any seed. The quantized baseline had lower AP than the float baseline. This does not establish product efficacy.

provenance.raw_artifact_policy: Raw reports are retained locally; their digests are recorded here. Model weights, images and serialized adapter binaries are not included in this summary or committed with it.

fresh_process_restore.limitation: one image in a separate process on the same host; not an independent environment or full-set reproduction

validation.test_command: python -m unittest tests.test_quantized_lora tests.test_cnn_qlora_ttt tests.test_packaged_tools_manifest tests.test_manifest_docs_references tests.test_ttt_docs_implementation_alignment tests.test_manual_ttt_chapter_structure
other_checks_passed: ruff on the five new Python files

limitations: One host, one checkpoint, one synthetic illumination shift, twelve evaluation images repeated across three seeds.
No real-camera adaptation efficacy or population-level accuracy estimate is established.
Timing was not isolated: the separate-process restore overlapped seed 22. Reported times are observations, not latency superiority evidence.
CPU process RSS is a process-lifetime high-water mark, not per-arm memory savings. GPU peak VRAM was not measured.
FP32 compute was used for both float and packed-INT4 paths; no FP16 comparison was executed.
AP did not improve despite nonzero adapter updates; larger updates or a different protocol require a new declared experiment.
